newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese schoolteachers to strike on Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese schoolteachers to strike on Nov 14.

text.p: Lebanon's 70,000 schoolteachers will go on a one-day strike on November 14 to press pay demands, the teachers' union said in a statement published on Wednesday.
They are protesting that the government has not included funds for agreed pay rises in its draft budget for 1997.
"The teachers' bureau decided to...declare a one-day warning strike on November 14 in all private and public schools," the statement said.
The new pay scales would cost the cash-strapped government 300 billion Lebanese pounds ($189 million), according to Beirut newspapers.
Acting Finance Minister Fouad Siniora said last month revenue would have to be raised outside the budget to pay for the pay increases.
The teachers "will adopt more escalatory steps" in December if their demands are not met, the statement said.
